integrity: The infinite statement is proved in formal power series over the integers. Exact coefficient computations are included only as reproducibility checks and are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact uniform p-adic modulus for each prime-power row, not the full distribution of higher valuations at individual coefficient indices; it makes no new claim for non-prime-power parameters.
title: Exact \(p\)-adic order of the prime-power Nekrasov--Okounkov/\(t\)-core congruence
